metadata.overview: Template Worker Plugin — talks to a device's HTTP JSON API over src/client.js. Replace the client, mock, contract and handlers with your own device's protocol.

telemetry.name: hashrate_rt
telemetry.description: Real-time throughput from the device's summary endpoint.

telemetry.name: power_mode
telemetry.description: Active power mode: eco, normal or high.

commands.name: reboot
commands.constraints: Do not call more than once per 5 minutes.

commands.name: setPowerMode
commands.description: Changes the power mode: eco, normal or high (low is accepted as an alias for eco).

errors.ERR_BAD_POWER_MODE: The device rejected the requested power mode.
errors.ERR_DEVICE_CALL_FAILED: The device's HTTP API call failed or returned an error.
